open_points.subject: A9 deployment-route identity
open_points.text: The check of rule 2 is built: it is the deployment route of this service, as it is the Client Portal's.
open_points.question: Is there one deployment route shared by this service and the Client Portal, or does each have a separate route that follows the same policy?
options: One shared deployment route checks both products.
A separate route for this service implements the same policy as the Client Portal's route.
open_points.default_guess: Use one shared deployment route for both products.

witness.initial: A deployment image is scanned against a ten-day-old OSV snapshot; the Client Portal's route considers snapshots older than seven days stale, while a separately configured service route would allow fourteen days.
events: The deployment operator submits the service image for deployment.
outcomes: A shared route refuses the image because the snapshot is stale under the Client Portal's limit.
A separate service route accepts the image because its own age limit treats the snapshot as current.

open_points.subject: A9 deployment admission
open_points.text: The check of rule 2 is built: it is the deployment route of this service, as it is the Client Portal's.
open_points.question: Must every deployment be admitted exclusively through the named route, or may another deployment mechanism admit an image after independently performing all checks in rule 2?
options: Only the named deployment route may admit the service.
Another mechanism may deploy the service if it performs all rule 2 checks.
Another mechanism may deploy without this route's check.
open_points.default_guess: Only the named deployment route may admit the service.

witness.initial: An image contains no known vulnerable distribution and an alternate deployment mechanism can perform the same complete scan against a snapshot accepted as current.
events: The deployment operator attempts to deploy the image through the alternate mechanism instead of the named route.
outcomes: The deployment is refused because admission is exclusive to the named route.
The deployment proceeds because the alternate mechanism independently satisfies every check in rule 2.
